SECTION_SPOTIFY_DESC: How this box appears to Spotify. Saving restarts playback.
SECTION_QUEUE_DESC: Mixed playlists: a Spotify row in a Volumio list plays here. Also shows the Spotify Queue tile on Browse. Applies immediately. Does not restart Soloist.
SECTION_CONVERT_DESC: Rewrite Spotify Connect (spop) track rows in a saved Volumio playlist so they play through Soloist. Clone is the default and leaves the original list alone. Does not restart Soloist and does not turn on queue playback.
CONVERT_PLAYLIST_SELECT_DOC: Only lists that still have Spotify Connect track rows. Re-open this page after you create a playlist. A list that is already soloist_connect does not appear.
CONVERT_OVERWRITE_DOC: Replace the selected playlist. Off by default: the original is kept and a copy is written. The new name below is ignored when this is on.
CONVERT_NAME_DOC: Used only when Overwrite in place is off. Leave empty for the source name plus (Soloist).
SECTION_SOUND_DESC: Level and buffering into the ALSA chain. Saving restarts playback.
SECTION_CACHE_DESC: Where downloaded audio is stored. Saving restarts playback.
SECTION_TIMING_DESC: How this plugin waits on a seek, an inactive blink, the quality label, and the Spotify Queue tile. Applies immediately. Does not restart Soloist.
SECTION_DIAGNOSTICS_DESC: Verbose logs for the plugin and the audio shim. Saving restarts so the shim picks this up.
API_KEY_DOC: Generate your own key at developer.spotify.com > Dashboard > Spotify Soloist API Key. A Premium account is required to generate the key. Keep it secret.
RETAIN_API_KEY_DOC: Keep your API key and paired Spotify session on this device if the plugin is uninstalled, so reinstalling does not require re-entering the key or pairing again. Turn this off to erase everything on uninstall.
DEVICE_NAME_DOC: The name shown in the Spotify app's device list.
INITIAL_VOLUME_DOC: Connect-side volume when Soloist starts (0-100). Mirrored to the Volumio mixer. Unused when Align volume on start is on, except as a fallback if Volumio has no mixer. The stream stays full scale unless Output Trim is set.
ALIGN_VOLUME_DOC: When this speaker becomes the active Connect device, copy Volumio's volume to Spotify instead of applying Initial Volume. Off by default. After that, the Spotify app slider still moves the mixer.
CACHE_SIZE_DOC: Maximum playback cache size. Use 0 for unlimited; otherwise minimum 100. In RAM mode this is capped to what the board can spare and the value you save may be reduced.
CACHE_LOCATION_DOC: Where Soloist stores downloaded audio. Disk keeps it on the data partition and survives a reboot. RAM keeps it in memory, which removes all cache writes from a slow SD card, but costs that much RAM and is emptied at every reboot and every plugin restart. A lossless track is roughly 44 MB, so 100 MB holds about two. Only choose RAM if the board has memory to spare: on a 512 MB board such as a Pi Zero 2 W it is a significant share of the total.
BUFFER_MS_DOC: How much audio is buffered ahead of the DAC (100-2000). Volumio's ALSA chain applies this value twice, so lower values make skip, seek and pause respond faster. Too low risks dropouts on a busy device. Default 500.
SEEK_COALESCE_MS_DOC: Wait this long after the last slider move before sending one seek to Spotify (0-2000). A drag can fire dozens of seeks in a second; each one flushes audio. 0 sends every move. Default 200.
INACTIVE_HOLD_MS_DOC: Wait this long after Spotify reports the device inactive before yielding the output (0-10000). A seek can blink inactive and come back; yielding on that blink ends the Connect session. After the session has already left this speaker, Spotify is not paused. 0 yields immediately. Default 2000.
QUALITY_RETRY_MS_DOC: How long to wait before looking again when the playing cache file is not ready (0-2000). 0 does not retry. Default 300.
QUALITY_RETRY_MAX_DOC: How many times to look again when the playing cache file is not ready (0-10). 0 does not retry. Default 2.
QUEUE_FETCH_MS_DOC: How long the Spotify Queue tile waits for a fresh list from Soloist (0-10000). 0 shows the last event immediately and still asks in the background. Default 2500.
OUTPUT_TRIM_DB_DOC: Fixed gain applied to the Soloist stream before the ALSA chain (-12 to +12). Raises or lowers what Peppy and SoftMaster see from this source. The volume knob is unchanged. Default 0. About +6 if the meters sit at half height.
LOUDNESS_NORMALIZATION_DOC: Spotify's own track-to-track level matching, written into the engine prefs at start. On is the current behaviour. Off leaves the original track level. This is not Output Trim. Saving restarts Soloist. The engine has no official switch for this.
CROSSFADE_DOC: Spotify's own fade between consecutive tracks, written into the engine prefs at start. Off is a hard cut, which is the current behaviour. This is not Output buffer. Saving restarts Soloist. The engine has no official switch for this.
CROSSFADE_MS_DOC: How long the fade lasts when Crossfade is on (1000-12000). Used only when the switch is on. Below 1000 does nothing. Default 2000. Saving restarts Soloist.
QUEUE_PLAYBACK: Play Spotify tracks from the Volumio queue
QUEUE_PLAYBACK_DOC: Let a Spotify track sitting in a Volumio playlist or queue play through Soloist, so one list can mix Spotify with local files, UPnP and web radio. Off by default. When this is on, a Spotify Queue tile also appears on Browse; tapping a track there uses the same play path. Off hides that tile, because those songs would otherwise skip. A Spotify entry needs service 'soloist_connect' in the playlist; entries saved for the old Spotify plugin say 'spop' and are not affected. Turning this off does not hide those rows: they still appear in the queue and are skipped when reached, and the list carries on with the next track. Requires a paired Spotify session; the Spotify app does not have to be open. Names and artwork come from what Soloist has already reported this session, so a track it has not seen shows a placeholder until it starts playing.
QUEUE_REMOTE_PLAYBACK: Let a queued track play on the active Spotify device
QUEUE_REMOTE_PLAYBACK_DOC: Only applies when the setting above is on. If the Spotify session has been moved to a phone, a speaker or another Connect device, a Spotify row in the Volumio queue plays there instead of here. Off by default, and off means such a row is skipped after a few seconds and the list moves on. Turning it on keeps that row with whichever device holds the session, so Volumio may not learn when it finishes and the list can wait on it. Next always works.
VERBOSE_DOC: Log every Soloist WebSocket event, and turn on the diagnostics in the audio shim: device lifecycle, per-second write counters, and what the shim does when ALSA reports a fault. Read with 'journalctl -u soloist -u volumio'. Changes no playback behaviour, but is noisy. Leave off unless investigating a problem.
SECTION_BACKUP_CREATE_DESC: Save the stored plugin settings on this device. The API key is written only when Retain my API key is on. This is not a clone of the Spotify login. The restore list updates on this page.
BACKUP_NAME_DOC: 1 to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens. A name that already exists is overwritten.
SECTION_BACKUP_RESTORE_DESC: Apply a named backup through the same checks as Save. A backup without an API key keeps the key already on this box. Restore of Spotify identity, sound, cache or diagnostics restarts Soloist. Queue and timing do not.
BACKUP_SELECTED_DOC: Named backups live under /data/INTERNAL/soloist_connect/backups and survive plugin uninstall.
SECTION_BACKUP_DELETE_DESC: Remove a named backup from this device. Live settings are not changed.
UPDATE_DESC: Spotify Soloist builds expire 90 days after their build date. On start the plugin re-downloads an already-dead build. While the plugin stays up, a once-a-day check can warn or, if you turn the switch on, pull a new binary when seven days or fewer remain. That silent pull does not reboot. The button here still shows a progress modal, then a 15 second reboot countdown with Restart and Cancel. We do not review the tarball Spotify serves. Do not power off while it downloads.
AUTO_UPDATE_BINARY: Download a new Soloist binary before it expires
AUTO_UPDATE_BINARY_DOC: Off by default. When on, a once-a-day check downloads from Spotify if the installed build has seven days or fewer left, or has already expired, and Spotify is not playing here. Web radio and other sources count as idle. The new binary is started in place. No reboot. The Update button below still reboots. We do not review that tarball. Applies immediately. Does not restart Soloist.
